title: Tehran , October 20 - Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC spokesman, made statements.
text:
Tehran , October 20 - Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC spokesman, made statements."

""
"SOT1, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi): "The Strait of Hormuz is closed; it is 100% closed. What does being "closed" mean? The meaning of being closed is that we do not allow any warship to enter the strait; we do not allow any American vessel to enter the strait; we do not allow any vessel belonging to the Zionist regime, or one carrying cargo for the Zionist regime, to enter.""

""
"SOT2, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi): "In terms of quality, the range of our missiles has increased, our destructive power has increased, the accuracy of our missiles' impact has increased, and the intelligence coefficient of our missiles has gone up. If we say that we are returning to how things were before the 40-day or 12-day war, it would mean we have actually stagnated.""

""
"SOT3, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi): "We will have weapons that allow us to defend ourselves against the enemy's weapons.""

""
"SOT4, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi): "Our defense doctrine moves toward creating permanent and absolute deterrence, meaning that no country would dare allow itself to encroach upon our country.""

""
"SOT5, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi): "This region is larger than what we currently have as a battlefield; it is more than that. We have not yet engaged the entire region. We have engaged an area, but not the whole region. Geographically, the entire region is broader and can, so to speak, cover other places and other targets, and in terms of depth, it holds greater strategic importance.""

""
"SOT6, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi): "We do not rule out the possibility that he might use this bomb [MOAB] and cause us some harm; however, this is a war, and it is a criminal country at that. It is not committed to anything, not to religion, nor law, nor custom, nor conscience, nor humanity; it adheres to nothing. Therefore, the possibility that it might do such a thing is not out of the question.""

""
"SOT7, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi): "This criminal country, this criminal president, this criminal army; it is possible for them to commit such a crime, but what achievement does it bring them? Nothing, they have no achievement. This will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz; this will not force Tehran or Iran to surrender; this will not force the people of Iran to surrender; this will not allow the country to be partitioned; this will not allow American dominance; this will not pursue America's goal of actually shortening the range of missiles; and this will not pursue the shutdown of Iran's nuclear industries.""

""
"SOT8, Hossein Mohebbi, IRGC Spokesman (Farsi): "We will never reconcile with America. It is possible that this war might end at some point by accepting our terms, by accepting our terms, but this does not mean that we will, for example, reconcile with them.
